- [ ] `npm run typecheck` is clean
- [ ] `npm test` passes (added/updated a test where it makes sense)
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes locally (if behavior-affecting)
- [ ] No new permissions, host access, network calls, or telemetry
- [ ] README / CHANGELOG updated if user-facing
